title: Lior and the Vow
author: Rafael Underhill
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
